parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of polypropylene plastic, designed to close over the seat.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl, reduce odor, and provide a clean appearance when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back, allowing it to open and close easily.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat is a ring-shaped component made of urea-formaldehyde plastic, designed for user comfort and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable and stable surface for sitting, separating the user from the ceramic bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward along with the lid via the hinge mechanism, allowing access to the bowl for cleaning or use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural component of the toilet, made of vitreous china ceramic.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, contains the water tank and bowl, and connects to the plumbing for flushing and drainage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains anchored to the floor or wall, providing stability to the entire toilet structure.
